name: ObjectOne Information Systems Limited
summary: ObjectOne Information Systems Ltd. is a technology company that provides a comprehensive suite of IT products and services to clients operating in various industries, including banking, insurance, professional services, media, telecommunications, and healthcare. Additionally, the firm is dedicated to the development and implementation of web applications, portal solutions, content management systems, search engine optimization (SEO), social media optimization (SMO), and mobile applications. The company was founded on February 6, 1996, and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
